name: Integration - ErrorHandler.handle_error returns correct error mapping
description: Checks that ErrorHandler.handle_error maps exceptions to correct error codes and messages.
input: Call ErrorHandler.handle_error with RuntimeError containing 'DOCUMENT_RETRIEVAL_ERROR', 'NO_EVIDENCE_FOUND', and a generic Exception
output: Dict with correct error_code and error message for each input
success_criteria: DOCUMENT_RETRIEVAL_ERROR maps to correct error_code and message
NO_EVIDENCE_FOUND maps to correct error_code and fallback message
Generic Exception maps to AGENT_ERROR and generic error message
